text:
Eli Moreno: Hey folks 44b Im Eli, starting today as a Backend Engineer on infra. Quick intro + setup thread. Im PST, planning to be in the SF office Friday afternoon. Two quick things: 1) can someone add me to the infra repos? I hit a 403 when cloning. 2) curious if I should request a spare M2 for local perf testing or start on my personal laptop. Fun fact: I once ran a pop-up coffee cart for a month.

Nora Kim: welcome eli!! :tada: adding you to the infra channel. For hardware: if you'll be running GPU tests locally, file the hardware request. Otherwise personal laptop is fine to get started. Ill DM you the repo owners for access.

IT Support: Hi Eli 44b Please submit a request at https://redwood.internal/it-requests (choose "Repo Access" and "Laptop Request" if needed). If you paste your GitHub handle here we can pre-stage invites. Yubikeys available at SF front desk.

Eli Moreno: GitHub handle: elimore. Quick reproduce of the clone error:

```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra-scripts.git
Cloning into 'infra-scripts'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

Any quick local fixes while IT spins up the ticket?

Carlos Vega: try `ssh -T git@github.com` to verify key. If you already have a key, make sure it's added to ssh-agent: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you don't have a key yet, generate one and add it to your GitHub profile. Happy to screenshare for 5-10m.

Onboarder Bot: Welcome Eli Moreno! Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist created. Next step: schedule 30m infra sync with team.

Samir Gupta: welcome eli! If you want a quick local perf rig without an M2, I can share a small docker image that emulates the runtime for lightweight tests. Also we have spare M2s in the SF office for short-term checkout.

Eli Moreno: Thanks all 60a I filed the IT request and pasted my SSH pub key in the ticket. Will take Carlos up on the screenshare if the clone still fails. Looking forward to Friday lunch and the coffee-cart story :coffee:
